d: Anthropic has reportedly created history with a record-breaking IPO, raising $81 billion and pushing its valuation close to $2 trillion. Founded just five years ago in 2021, the AI company made a spectacular debut on the Nasdaq on November 19. Its shares, initially priced at $83 after strong investor demand, surged more than 34% to cross $111 before closing at $97. The IPO surpassed SpaceX's reported $75 billion offering in June 2026, setting a new record for the largest IPO in history. But the biggest winners may be Anthropic's employees.
